items.title: Reaction list opens and dismisses accessibly
items.precondition: An isolated runtime with a post, comment, or post image that has reactions.
steps: Confirm focus moves to the close control and background scrolling is disabled.
Dismiss with Escape, the backdrop, and the close control in separate runs.
items.expected: A labelled dialog appears, each dismissal closes it, and normal page scrolling returns.
items.evidence: Static review confirms portal rendering, aria-modal semantics, Escape listener, backdrop button, and overflow cleanup.

items.title: Reaction filtering returns the scoped people list
items.precondition: An isolated runtime with at least two populated reaction emoji types.
steps: Select each emoji filter and then All.
Compare the heading count and listed people to the selected reaction type.
items.expected: The active filter and the matching entries/counts are correct; an empty, loading, or error state is understandable.
items.evidence: Static review confirms filter state is passed to the existing useReactionsList hook.

items.title: Dialog works at desktop and mobile sizes
items.precondition: An isolated runtime with enough reactions to scroll the list.
steps: Open the dialog at desktop width.
Repeat at a narrow mobile width.
Scroll the list, then open a person profile.
items.expected: The dialog is centered on desktop and bottom-aligned on mobile, the list scrolls inside the dialog, and profile navigation closes it.
items.evidence: Static review confirms responsive placement classes, max-height, overflow, and link close handling.
